findings.description: MB-010c::findings well formed checks only that fields are nonempty strings; no check rejects duplicate or multiple entries for the same defect.

findings.citation: List only defects that contributed to the outcome above.
findings.description: The review checks observe category names and field shape, but never validate that each location and defect statement describes a real contributing defect; fabricated findings using an expected category would pass.

The checks require three expected categories and exclude four other allowed categories, but MB-010c::findings well formed accepts any nonempty category string, so an out-of-enum category is not rejected.
